strategies.name: US Equity Bull 2x/3x ETP Constant-Leverage 15:55 Washout (CORE)
strategies.universe_rule: US Equity Bull Leveraged ETPs (Index/Sector TQQQ, SOXL, SPXL, TNA, TECL, FAS + ER-Guarded Single-Stock 2x Bull; Unadj >= $5, ADTV >= $15M; Commodity/VIX & Inverse ETPs excluded)
strategies.signal_rule: z1d_c ≤ -1.50σ AND IBS ≤ 0.15 (pinned in bottom 15% of day's range at 15:55)
strategies.hedge_rule: 100% IRA Cash Long-Only (BUY at 15:55 ET -> SELL Next Day 09:30–09:35 ET); zero margin, zero borrow; block Single-Stock 2x ETPs on underlying [ER-1d, ER]; <=5% IRA cap & <=0.5% ADTV cap.
strategies.structural_why: Constant-leverage ETP swap desks have structural negative gamma (ΔRebal = L(L-1)·AUM·r) and are contractually forced to dump underlying delta into 15:50–16:00 NAV fixings on trend down-days.
strategies.placebo_note: SLEDGEHAMMER SURVIVOR: Index/Sector Bull ETPs print +60.1 bps net (t=+2.63, Sharpe 2.26) & All ER-Guarded US Equity Bull prints +50.4 bps net (t=+2.74, Sharpe 2.33); Commodity/VIX ETPs (-12.1 bps) & Inverse ETPs (-7.0 bps) falsified and stripped; 15:55->09:35 exit retains +91.5 bps gross.

strategies.name: SEC Rule 10b-18 MOC Vacuum (+15:00–16:00 NLP News & ER Blackout)
strategies.universe_rule: Large/Mega-Cap (MCap >= $10B), PIT Quarterly OCF > 0, Open >= $20, ADTV >= $20M, OUTSIDE [ER-14d, ER+1d] blackout & ZERO 15:00–16:00 corporate headlines
strategies.hedge_rule: 100% IRA Long-Only: BUY Stock + BUY beta_20d * SH (ProShares 1x Inverse S&P 500 ETF) at 15:55 ET -> SELL both Next Day 10:00 AM ET (or Pure Unhedged Long Stock mode; +161.7 bps in 1Y 5m sample).
strategies.structural_why: SEC Rule 10b-18(b)(2)(ii) forces corporate buyback desks to pull bids during the final 10–30m of RTH just as passive/risk-parity MOC sells hit, creating an artificial air-pocket that snaps back when 10b-18 bids turn back on at 09:35–10:00 AM.
strategies.placebo_note: IRA LONG-ONLY SURVIVOR: Blocking [ER-14d, ER+1d] 10b-18 blackouts & afternoon corporate news + hedging via cash BUY SH yields +113.3 bps net (62.0% WR, t=+2.91, zero shorting).

strategies.name: Point-in-Time S&P 500 1-of-N Capitulation Sector-ETF Pair Trade
strategies.universe_rule: Point-in-Time S&P 500 Constituent, Price >= $20, ADTV >= $25M, OUTSIDE [ER-1d, ER+1d] Earnings Announcements
strategies.signal_rule: ind_resid_z ≤ -2.50σ (isolated vs narrow peers), RVOL ≥ 2.5x, IBS ≤ 0.25
strategies.hedge_rule: 100% IRA Long-Only: BUY PIT S&P 500 Stock + BUY beta_20d * SH (1x Inverse S&P 500 ETF) at 15:55 ET -> SELL both at Close + 3 Trading Days (zero shorting required).
strategies.structural_why: Active pod-shop risk managers enforce mechanical drawdown liquidations into the close when a single S&P 500 constituent suffers an isolated 2.5σ+ selloff while its narrow industry peers stay flat; mandatory S&P index passive inflows absorb the exhausted supply over T+1..T+3.
strategies.placebo_note: IRA LONG-ONLY SURVIVOR: Point-in-Time S&P 500 + blocking 245/407 Earnings Crash days + cash BUY SH beta hedge yields +104.6 bps net (t=+2.21, N=162, zero shorting).

sls_case_study.verdict: Optical Reclaim Illusion: SLS reclaims its 09:30 open 69.8% of the time on small dips, but capping upside at the open while eating -8% to -15% uncapped ATM shelf-offering liquidation days + $0.01 Reg NMS tick drag (~46.5 bps RT at $4.30) turns it strongly negative (-40.1 to -80.6 bps/trade). Upgrading to S4 ($5+ floor, bounded -1.2σ..-3.0σ industry gap, quiet prior RVOL ≤ 1.5x) converts biotech dislocations into +172.6 bps/trade net.

graveyard.family: Unbounded Overnight Gap Fades (> 3.5σ Gaps Up or Down)
graveyard.why_failed: Extreme gaps (> 3σ) contain true information (earnings PEAD, M&A, FDA Phase 3 failures, S-3 offerings) that drift in the gap direction all day.
Selecting top 'habitual morning dippers' in Train (+62.6 bps) completely inverts Out-of-Sample (-34.5 bps net) once corporate ATM/VWAP programs finish.
Profitable on FISV/PLNT/NU (+33 bps corrected), but across 245 other stocks intraday VWAP dips lack active corporate buyback absorption.
